summary: RPM install secret locations: controller uses `/etc/tower/SECRET_KEY` (encrypts database secrets; if lost, encrypted fields are unreadable), `/etc/tower/tower.cert` and `tower.key`, `/etc/tower/conf.d/postgres.py` (DB password), `channels.py` (WebSocket broadcast secret) and `gateway.py` (gateway sync key). Platform gateway uses `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/SECRET_KEY` and `gateway.cert`.
questions: Where is the automation controller SECRET_KEY stored?
Where is the controller database password stored in an RPM install?
Where is the platform gateway TLS certificate on RPM installs?

answer_card.title: Automation controller secret files (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
| File | Holds |
|---|---|
| `/etc/tower/SECRET_KEY` | Key that encrypts secrets in the DB. Lose or change it and encrypted fields can't be read |
| `/etc/tower/tower.cert`, `/etc/tower/tower.key` | Web service TLS cert and key (self-signed by default) |
| `/etc/tower/conf.d/postgres.py` | DB password (unless DB TLS auth is used) |
| `/etc/tower/conf.d/channels.py` | WebSocket broadcast secret |
| `/etc/tower/conf.d/gateway.py` | Key to sync state with platform gateway |

Gateway: `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/SECRET_KEY` and `gateway.cert`.
